title: Deep Learning Techniques for Ear Diseases Based on Segmentation of the Normal Tympanic Membrane.
summary: Deep-learning segmentation of normal tympanic membranes supported automated ear-disease classification; the paper reports diagnostic performance on its labeled image set, with dataset scope limiting generalization. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
ai_technology: The study uses a deep neural network for the stated deep learning techniques for ear diseases based on segmentation of the normal tympanic membrane task.
